profile.headline: Software Engineer @ FAANG Company | Prev Network Engineer IV @ Charter Communications, Test Engineer & Network Engineer @ Lumen Technologies, Software DevOps @ Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
I am a results-driven computer science professional with a Bachelor of Science from the University of Colorado Boulder, Class of 2019. Since beginning my technical career while still a student, I have gained hands-on experience in a wide range of roles within the Denver Metropolitan Area, contributing to high-impact engineering teams at Fortune 500 companies such as Intel Corporation, Spectrum @ Charter Communications, and Quantum Fiber @ Lumen Technologies.

I have continuously advanced my expertise in network engineering, DevOps, software development and testing, and automation. I thrive on solving complex technical challenges and driving operational efficiency, always seeking innovative ways to enhance performance and productivity.

With a passion for optimizing systems and ensuring smooth, seamless functionality, I strive to deliver high-quality solutions in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Google ChromeOS Incident Management Triage Team
ChromeOS and Kernel Engineering
Cross functional expertise: understand, troubleshoot and resolve firmware, hardware, linux kernel, graphics, etc, issues by co-working with internal functional teams
Manage incoming bugs from Users, partners, testing team and help triage issues to drive resolution across internal functional teams
Improve processes, infrastructure, tests and tools based on experience of managing issues to ease the life of issue management
Ensure the issue contains relevant information for teams to debug and resolve the issue (log files, repro scenario..), track the resolutions of blocking bugs and analyze bug trends to send reports
Build tools to generate reliable logs, build systems to analyze logs and help ChromeOS ecosystem quality by helping the team to address incoming bugs.
Technical documentation of the troubleshooting process for various domains within Google architecture
positions.insights: Skills: Linux Kernel · QA Engineering · QA Automation · Chrome OS · Chrome DevTools · Operating Systems · Linux · Software Development · Software Testing · Firmware

positions.title: Network Engineer III
positions.description:
Field Incident Resolution Engineering (FIRE) Team within Charter Communications/Spectrum
AI/ML powered Automated Testing and Validation processes using jump servers, Python API scripting, ssh protocols, and automatic log generation, using company internal AI/ML tools.
Advanced knowledge of the DOCSIS (3.0 & 3.1) and EPON standards
CMTS Platforms such as CASA, Arris, Cisco, vCMTS, RPDs
EPON platforms such as Adtran, Vecima, and Distributed Access Architecture (DAA)
Troubleshoot and resolve escalated Access and CPE device field issues
Assessment of existing technologies to determine performance and capacity gaps
Established security, connectivity and access parameters.
Programming of routers and switches. Implemented communications technologies (data or voice).
Investigate and report on software, firmware, and hardware related issues affecting field devices
Replicate reported issues and generate logs with relevant information and pointers
Coordinate with vendors to produce better product and service to our end clients/customers
Firmware validation for network devices such as CPE, CMTS, RPDs, DAA devices, ONUs, ONTs, etc.
Specialized usage of testing equipment including customer premise equipment, signal level meters, signal noise generators, telephony devices, Raspberry Pi's, etc.
Detailed technical documentation of all work and test plans.
positions.insights: Skills: DOCSIS · DAA · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Cable Networks · Hybrid Fiber-Coaxial (HFC) · Cable Modem Termination System (CMTS) · OSI Model · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Virtual Private Network (VPN) · Network Switches · Network Design · Network Security · Network Troubleshooting · Troubleshooting

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Local server and cloud-based solutions for file sharing, email/faxing, user authentication, network and endpoint security, remote access, building management, data backup, End User Computing (EUC) such as VDI
•	Managing and completing long-term technical projects
•	Use of python and shell scripting to automate set up and service tasks
•	Remote and on-site administration of full-suite IT services including installation, management, and support.
•	EUC environments including full desktop/laptop and VDI/session-based
•	Work with clients onsite to build and manage IT systems and handle End User support requests. Strong interpersonal skills.
•	Access-control, cybersecurity, monitoring and surveillance, and incident resolution at client sites including national.
•	Work within ticketing system to resolve reported issues and track project progress.
•	Work with project managers to keep track of project milestones and timelines.
•	Stay informed with the AVAJEN monitoring system to ensure client network uptime and ultra-fast problem resolution.
•	Work with the AVAJEN Rockstar team to evaluate the technologies in place as well as new technologies to continuously re-imagine and improve the way we provide IT services.
•	Track all working time in ticketing/billing system
positions.insights: Skills: Network Services · Storage Area Network (SAN) · Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) · Desktop Virtualization · Interpersonal Skills

positions.title: Wi-fi Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lumen’s rockstar router firmware validation team: discovering and tracking defects and coordinating fixes with dev team.
•	Development and administration of VMware products, services, and tools across linux servers in several locations.
•	Verified firmware adherence to design specifications and functionality across diverse operating conditions. 
•	Developed an internal web application for device onboarding and API feature testing, improving development efficiency.
•	Expert in testing CPE routers, commercial routers, and various WiFi protocols including 802.11x and Wifi 7.
•	Use of iPerf, wireshark for active logging of bandwidth, throughput monitoring on TCP, SCTP, UDP over multiple platforms
•	Implemented and maintained monitoring solutions such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack for real-time visibility into system performance and health.
•	RESTful API scripting, programming, and testing in Postman API Platform and in python for robust API functionality
•	Managed application deployment and scalability with Kubernetes and Docker, optimizing infrastructure efficiency.
•	Tested emerging WiFi standard (WiFi 7/802.11be) across multiple radio bands (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz) for performance and compliance.
•	Automated QA testing using Python, JSON, and MongoDB on Linux servers
•	Configured network test lab environments to replicate production environment and validate network equipment.
•	Tested GA-candidate firmware, Plume integration, Axon Orchestrator, and facilitated remote access for routers/modems.
•	Collaborated cross-functionally with app teams, network engineers, WiFi teams, and vendors to achieve project goals.
•	Managed device preparation, testing, triage, and firmware updates, supporting teams in defect resolution.
•	Collaborated with leadership teams to plan marketing campaigns
positions.insights: Skills: Firmware · Testing · Customer-Premises Equipment (CPE) · Network Engineering · Software Development · Gigabit-Capable Passive Optical Network (GPON) · Fiber Optics · Optical Fiber · Technical Documentation · VLAN · Digital Subscriber Line Access Multiplexer (DSLAM) · Provisioning · Software Testing · Operating Systems · Systems Engineering · Wide Area Network (WAN) · WiFi · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · API Development · API Testing · REST APIs · Postman API · Docker Products · Docker Swarm

positions.title: Network Engineer III
positions.description:
• Charter Communications/Spectrum’s premiere router firmware team, focus on wi-fi innovation, defect tracking, etc.
• Pitched, owned, maintained, and managed team’s asset management software through robust API open-source solution
• Automated entries and changes to inventory management software using python API scripts
• AWS EC2 spin up for hosting health-check and asset management software/webapps 
• Wrote webapp for checking testing setup health and display of potential issues, for offshore testing to find available setups
• Wrote automated health restore script for common issues that result from firmware testing (flapping interfaces, and more)
• Updating health-check software for automation testing, taking it further to interface with asset software through API
• Triage and troubleshoot lab setups – Routers, firmware, modem, raspberry pi, management network, etc.
• Soldering serial connectors, flashing firmware, installing bypass files to prepare routers for dev test environment
• Configuring setups for automation testing: managed switches, raspberry pi, wi-fi and network
• Facilitated in growing and expanding lab space, including expansion to secondary and tertiary corporate offices
• On-site and WFH work balancing lab work and programming/software development
• Build of “Full-Access” setups, giving offshore testing teams a near-hands-on level of control over local devices
• Fulfillment of requests using JIRA, use of JIRA to record work and progress on priority tasks
positions.insights: Skills: Web Services API · API Management · Test Execution · Asset Management · Facility Expansion

positions.title: Linux DevOps, Software Engineer, Lab Manager
positions.description:
• Intel’s NSG team bought by SK Hynix/Solidigm for 208 trillion Won ($9Bln USD) during employment, in October 2020
• Facilitated and maintained remote access to servers and testing equipment for coworkers WFH during Covid-19 pandemic.
• Configured network & switches to comply with new security rules regarding different machines and purposes.
• Manage a team of lab technicians with supervision on maintaining an efficient and reliable testing lab
• Managed hardware testing lab room and server racks, KVMs, Raritan, networking, power provisioning.
• Maintain lab and rack system inventory and organized system pool, backups, etc.
• Use of Python, Bash, C, and Java in software development and engineering and automating tasks.
• Proficiency in using advanced operations in powershell and command terminal on Windows and Linux OS.
• Performance tested and published detailed comparison results for NAND vs. Optane NVMe SSDs.
• Troubleshoot and fix/restore bricked NVMe SSD drives and updated/flashed firmware using specialized tools.
• Troubleshoot and fix computer hardware components, software, FW, drivers, network issues, etc.
• Building and configuring and maintenance of test client systems & servers to specified testing configs.
• Familiarity with several Linux OSes (Ubuntu, RHEL, SUSE/SLES, CentOS, etc.) and deployment across multiple systems.
• Creation of JIRA tickets for requests, progress tracking, and documentation.
• Documentation of Best-Known Methods (BKMs) and publishing on Intel Internal Wiki.
• Fulfilled vital role in facilitating the transfer of Longmont Intel campus to new company SK Hynix/Solidigm.
• Accelerated training of new hires for managing lab responsibilities

positions.title: Operations Technician
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and deployed applications for use in managing identities of over 300,000 users.
• Handled and documented incidents, automated processes, management of big data
• Use of AGILE methodologies in building, designing, and managing a database and related projects
• Use of Python, Java, SQL, shell, bash, and groupersh to develop tools for Identity Management
• Experience in usage of Message Queues, Active Directory, Docker, Enterprise Database, Oracle Identity Manager

positions.title: Student Operations Technician
positions.description:
Started at CU's OIT on the Identity and Access Management team.
- Use of identity management software such as Grouper, Internet2, Active Directory, Messaging Queues, OIM.
- Handled and documented incidents and solutions
- Automated processes for bitbucket/stash/git deployment
- Use of Python, SQL, shell, bash, and groupersh to develop tools for IAM team.

positions.title: Test Lead
positions.description:
Worked with nonprofit startup in Boulder as a part of Senior Capstone Project.
• Developed, Tested, Deployed, and Managed website on AWS for nonprofit organization
• Use of Agile with small team of students for creating website from scratch

positions.title: Subcontractor
positions.description:
- Gained experience as a subcontractor working on building construction and renovation.
- Handled daily construction and renovation of customers' homes such as installing or repairing electrical wiring, plumbing, drywall, painting, woodwork, caulking.
- Meticulous attention to detail in making beautiful living spaces.
- Assisted other personnel as needed to maintain professional work and safety.

positions.title: Student Assistant Cook
positions.description:
Student job in campus' main dining hall.
- Prepped food within university main dining hall with >1000 guests daily
- Trained, managed, and guided multiple other line cooks improving overall performance and quality of service
